## Teaching points

1. Ascending areflexic weakness requires urgent respiratory and autonomic assessment. Oxygen saturation alone does not assess ventilatory reserve.
2. Serial bulbar, respiratory and autonomic assessment is essential. Do not wait for CSF or nerve-conduction confirmation to seek specialist care.
3. Respiratory mechanics and IVIG/plasma exchange are not implemented orders. The station evaluates recognition and safe escalation, not definitive immunotherapy delivery.
